methodSections.heading: French Onion Soup
steps: In a saucepan on a medium heat, melt the butter then add the sliced onions and cook down until golden brown and caramelised.
Add the flour and cook for 3-4 minutes stirring constantly to make a roux.
Add both the sherry and sherry vinegar and both stocks and stir over a medium heat for 15-20 minutes. Season to taste.

Pour the soup into 4 bowls and place croutons on top. Lay the cheese on top and brûlée with a kitchen blow-torch. If you don't have a blow-torch, place the bowls in the oven set to broil until cheese is melted and browned.
